mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to remodel my bathroom in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text:
In most cases, yes—if you’re doing more than cosmetic changes, you’ll need permits in Los Angeles County. Any work involving plumbing, electrical, structural changes, or altering ventilation almost always requires one.

Some very minor cosmetic updates like painting, replacing a faucet, or swapping a toilet like‑for‑like may not require permits, but full remodels typically do. Working without permits can cause problems when selling your home and with insurance if something goes wrong.

KEY FACTORS:
- Moving or adding plumbing fixtures (shower, toilet, sinks)
- Upgrading electrical circuits, lights, or fans
- Restructuring walls, windows, or doors
- City or county jurisdiction and HOA rules

Before starting, ask your contractor exactly which permits are needed and who is responsible for obtaining them. In LA County, verify that permit costs and inspection time are built into the schedule and budget. A professional used to local codes and Title 24 energy requirements will save you headaches later.
